class.name: IfcDamper
class.brief_description: A damper typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the flow of air. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcDamper defines the occurrence of any damper; common information about damper types is handled by IfcDamperType . The IfcDamperType (if present) may establish the common type name, usage (predefined type), properties, materials,
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
